DEC-recipe_analogy.exact_quote: yes. padgett could be topping city. he may even have an original copy of the lost recipe we're reconstructing with tests, only written differently, not as a recipe, but as a telling of the recipe within the larger story he is telling. maybe his story he is telling talks about the pie from the perspective of a person outside a restaurant looking in at the people eating it...maybe he talks about the pie from the perspective of someone at tyhe table who's actually eating it...maybe he talks about the perspective of the chef who is cooking it, or maybe just the server who serves it. maybe his story does not talk about the pizza or it's recipe at all, but is an absolute perfect accounting for the flour tilling process, or the exact right tomatos. and maybe (though i would say not in padgetts case) his story is about fish, and not one single pizza ingredient is present so his recipe is not applicable. each has value to us and can illuminate something about our lost recipe we are reconstructing, but the onus is on us to determine that. one tells us how it's servd, another tells us how it should smell, another tells us how to actually make it, another tells us the effects it has on those eating it. each validates or disvalidates what we'bve put together so far.  looking at the relevance of him, an ordinary joe, spontyaneously understanding the secrets of the universe after a part of him and his ego were so fully mangled, becoming a genius savant he was noit borne as may be important and it may not
